method: Exact text-normalized model + model-year comparison of source manifests; China examples parsed from data-search attributes with limited aliases. Drom 991 was a count, only 40 listings were inspected. Existing source Japan has duplicates and two quarantined examples; count on live gallery is 412. Model year coverage is not identity/provenance of the same Drom vehicle. Missing range years are sourcing hints, not observed Drom years. China origin and market are distinct.
limitations: model aliases and equipment years can produce false gaps; do not assert manufacturing years from ambiguous supplier titles
uninspected 951 Drom listings are not classified
photo and document rights are not verified; this is research only, not publication approval
Japan archive reference pages are not live stock
China supplier examples are not Japanese-style auction lots and have no verified full auction sheets
